summary: Genealogy is a self-hosted application designed for recording family members and mapping their relationships to build a comprehensive family tree. It provides a centralised digital space to store personal history, dates, and lineage data on your own infrastructure. The project is written in PHP and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for hobbyists and researchers who want to privately manage and map their family history using a lightweight, open-source stack.
watchOut: The moderate maintenance activity and smaller community size mean you may encounter fewer third-party plugins and slower responses to bugs compared to larger mainstream alternatives.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, you will typically need to run it behind a standard web server like Nginx or Apache with PHP-FPM, alongside a compatible database such as MySQL or MariaDB and persistent storage for uploaded media.
